subject: english
stem: This talk happens while both speakers have time to make a change. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: reporting that the book cartons are already missing
asking permission to borrow the book cartons
asking permission to borrow the paint boxes
asking to keep the book cartons after next Friday

optionRationales.reason: reporting that the book cartons are already missing：此項把「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」改成「reporting that the book cartons are already missing」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。
asking permission to borrow the book cartons：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。
asking permission to borrow the paint boxes：此項把「book cartons」改成「paint boxes」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。

asking to keep the book cartons after next Friday：此項把「permission to borrow the book cartons」改成「to keep the book cartons after next Friday」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the book cartons」。
